div.p: Science is the systematic study of the natural world. It relies on observation, experimentation, and evidence — not opinions.

ul.li: Physical Science — matter and energy (chemistry + physics)

ol.li: Form a testable hypothesis (If… then… because…)
Design and run a controlled experiment

ul.li: Independent Variable — what you change on purpose

div.p: The control group does not receive the treatment so you have something to compare against.
